summary: Two independent contract failures reproduced: stale classic callback corrupts undo semantics; non-auto classic options advance Mythic regenerate checkpoint RNG.

findings.title: Reject stale classic generation callbacks before drawing RNG or capturing a second transaction
findings.method: Independent real App handler harness with React hook storage substituted; no algorithm or production RNG replacement.
steps: Create seed 0 classic world; choose locality.
Capture generateAt from one render. Invoke at (0,0); render committed result.
Invoke the same captured callback at (0,0) again; render and undo.
findings.expected: Second callback is stale and makes no change to document, RNG, or history.
findings.actual: First: 1 region/1 undo, streams geography=872447858 poi=2590494572. Duplicate: 1 region/2 undo, streams geography=2752802268 poi=2526553375. Undo duplicate: 0 regions while retaining RNG after first action.
findings.impact: Violates stale-callback contract and produces an undo transaction that does not restore the first committed map. The failure is proven at the production handler boundary; ordinary physical mouse double-click reachability was not independently reproduced in a local browser.
findings.requested_change: Validate action/document freshness from authoritative refs before any seed/options draw and commit; add regression covering repeated captured classic callbacks and exact undo contents.

findings.title: Preserve pre-option RNG in Mythic regeneration checkpoint
findings.method: Independent real App handler sequence with product mulberry32 and complete multi-step kingdom generation.
steps: Seed 0; choose locality in classic controls, then switch to Mythic.
Generate one complete kingdom. Its current geography is 1193655228.
Regenerate last kingdom to completion; inspect its generation checkpoint.
Delete last kingdom and inspect RNG.
findings.expected: Regenerate checkpoint contains restored base world and RNG at the start of regeneration: geography=1193655228, poi=1266212832.
findings.actual: buildGenerationOptions consumes hidden classic locality draw first, moving geography to 3025221041. startKingdom captures this advanced RNG; final checkpoint and delete-last both restore geography=3025221041 instead of 1193655228.
findings.impact: The new Mythic checkpoint does not represent the RNG start of regenerate required by TX-05. Existing tests use auto size, so option preparation spends no draw and misses this case.
findings.requested_change: Carry the original regeneration-start RNG into the base-map checkpoint, keeping full failure backup separate; avoid irrelevant hidden classic option draws for Mythic if compatible with the contract. Add non-auto classic-control→Mythic regenerate/delete tests.
